entities.name: Q9C6S5 At1g31830
observations: Reviewed Arabidopsis thaliana protein with exact sequence match to the query (100% identity and coverage; E-value 0).
Annotated as a probable cell-membrane polyamine/proton symporter involved in polyamine uptake.
Annotated with polyamine transmembrane transporter activity (GO:0015203) and polyamine transport (GO:0015846).
Localized to the plasma membrane and chloroplast; classified as a multipass membrane protein.
Sequence length is 495 aa; estimated molecular mass 54.83 kDa and theoretical pI 5.92.
Pfam domains AA_permease_2 (PF13520) and AA_permease (PF00324) span most of the sequence, consistent with a multipass amino-acid/polyamine permease.

observations: Reviewed Arabidopsis thaliana polyamine transporter homolog with 69.7% identity and approximately 97% query coverage to the query sequence.
